# UX & Behaviour Requirements Quality Checklist: Reset View Button

**Purpose**: Checks that the requirements for the "Reset view" control are complete, clear, consistent and measurable. Covers two areas: (1) the starting view and the reset behaviour, (2) the control's look, placement and accessibility. For PR reviewers, before implementation.
**Created**: 2026-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/reset-view-control.md](../contracts/reset-view-control.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Is the default starting view (center coordinates and zoom) stated as exact values in the requirements, not only as "Paris at zoom 13"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK002 - Is the zoom level of the location-centered starting view stated as a requirement (zoom 15), not only implied by current behaviour? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, Clarifications] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK003 - Does the spec say what happens to an open destination popup when the view is reset? FR-005 lists the destination marker but not its popup. [Gap, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK004 - Does the spec say where keyboard focus goes after the control is activated (stays on the button or moves elsewhere)? [Gap, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK005 - Does the spec say whether the reset is announced to assistive technology (for example through the status region), given that FR-005 forbids changing the status message? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK006 - Are visual states for the control (default, hover, focus, active) defined, or explicitly delegated to "same as other map controls"? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [ ] CHK007 - Is the control's visible content (text label, icon, or both) decided? Or is the "text and/or icon" choice explicitly left to design? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 - Is "once startup positioning was done" (FR-002) defined precisely enough to match FR-003's "first location fix" rule, with no other way to read it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [ ] CHK009 - Is "alongside the existing map controls" given a specific location (corner or position relative to the zoom control and attribution)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK010 - Is "small screens" defined with a viewport size or breakpoint for the no-overlap rule? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-007] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK011 - Is "recognizable icon" defined, or is the chosen symbol named? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK012 - Is "the same center and zoom" given a tolerance (for example, exact zoom and center within a set number of pixels or metres), so results can be compared objectively? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §SC-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK013 - Does the spec say whether the move to the starting view is animated or instant? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 - Is FR-007 ("MUST NOT overlap … the zoom controls") consistent with the current layout, where the search panel may already cover the default top-left zoom control? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Plan research R4] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK015 - Do acceptance scenario 1.2 ("nothing else changes") and FR-005 list the same set of preserved state? [Consistency, Spec §US1-2, §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK016 - Is the edge case "press Reset before the location is known; the first fix still centers the map" consistent with FR-004's "starting view MUST NOT change after it has been set"? In other words, is the default view clearly described as provisional rather than "set"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §Edge Cases] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK017 - Is the accessible name "Reset view" stated the same way in FR-001, FR-006 and US2-2? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-006, §US2] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 - Is SC-004 ("first-time user … under 5 seconds without instructions") measurable, with the test method and the number of participants defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK019 - Is the start and end of the 1-second window in SC-002 defined (from activation to the end of the animation, or to the first frame at the target)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK020 - Can SC-003 ("100% of the route, destination and search state … still shown") be checked against an explicit list of state items? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK021 - Do the US2 acceptance scenarios define pass/fail for both the Enter and the Space key, and for the announced role and name? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US2] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements defined for the case where the user pans or zooms **before** the first location fix arrives? Does the first fix still re-center the map, overriding the user's manual view? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are requirements defined for the case where a destination is chosen before any location fix (the map centers on the destination), and then the first fix arrives? [Coverage, Spec §FR-003, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 - Are requirements defined for when location access is granted after an earlier denial in the same session? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §US1-5] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK025 - Are requirements defined for when the location fails after a successful first fix? Does the starting view stay at the first fix? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-004] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 - Does the spec address viewport resize or orientation change? Reset keeps the same center and zoom, but the visible area changes. Is that the intended behaviour? [Edge Case, Gap] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK027 - Does the spec address activating the control while a tile layer or route request is still loading? Does the reset affect in-flight route or pleasure computation? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-005] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK028 - Does the spec say whether the control stays enabled (not disabled or hidden) when the map is already at the starting view? [Edge Case, Spec §US1-2, §FR-001] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 - Is a minimum touch-target size specified for the control on touch devices? [Gap, Non-Functional, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK030 - Are a visible focus indicator and a contrast requirement for the control specified? [Gap, Accessibility, Spec §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK031 - Is reduced-motion behaviour (`prefers-reduced-motion`) specified for the reset transition? [Gap, Accessibility] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK032 - Is the assumption "reuse the map library's standard control placement and styling" consistent with FR-006's native-button, keyboard-operable requirement, given that the library's own controls use links rather than buttons? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-006] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK033 - Is the assumption that the reset does not request a new location fix written as a testable requirement, not only as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions] — reviewed by the factory, 2026-11-11
- [x] CHK034 - Is the out-of-scope status of "clear search/routes" stated explicitly enough that reviewers will not expect the control to clear them? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-005] — covered, ticked by the factory, 2026-11-11
